23-way 2.54mm single-row socket, 8.5mm insulation height, 3mm tails, gold-flash contacts. 260 in stock, MOQ 5 = $1.15. Socket hangs below the interface board and receives the 15.75mm posts of J3 across the fixed 20.00mm standoff gap (socket body bottom at 11.5mm, pin tip at 15.75mm). Backup: HC-PM254-8.5H-1x24PZ = C41376163 (15714 stock, cut one position).

23-way single-row 2.54mm THT header, .025in square posts, tin, lead style 17 = .620in (15.75mm) post above a 2.54mm plastic body, .830in (21.08mm) overall. The long post is what reaches the interface-board sockets across the fixed 20.00mm stack: measured requirement is 16.0 +/-0.25mm above the controller PCB, geometry says 15.75-16.25mm, and 15.75mm is the only stocked lead style in that window (-15 is 13.21mm, -18 is 18.29mm and would bottom out). In stock at Samtec, $1.516 ea. Exact-height alternative if 15.75mm proves marginal: MTSW-123-10-T-S-630 (.630in = 16.00mm post), build-to-order, no stock. Tail is 2.79mm = 1.19mm proud of a 1.6mm board.
